question: What is the meaning of reused content in relation to chemical properties?
description: Reused content refers to parts of a product that have been repurposed or recycled. In relation to chemical properties, this information would pertain to the presence and mass fraction of these reused parts within the total product mass, as specified in the ISO 59040:2025 standard. This data is crucial for assessing the environmental impact and safety of the product, especially considering the chemical composition and potential health risks associated with the reused materials.
